messages:
marta: Heads-up — telemetry flagged an ingress 5xx surge in eu-west-1. Deploybot just quarantined the 10:30 release slot. Can we confirm an incident hold and quick mitigation plan?

deploy-bot: [automated] deploybot quarantined release slot 2026-06-10T10:30Z due to service.edge 5xx rate > threshold. Quarantine window: 10:30-11:00. Reason: increased queue drops at edge proxies.

leo: Confirming hold. Proposal: tag the slot DO_NOT_REQUEUE, pin canary to last-stable tag (v5.0.2), and open a new tentative window later today with micro-stagger. Also recommend canary-only revert of the recent "batch-accel" runtime flag.

anika: I can revert the flag on canaries now. It's likely the cause — enabled in yesterday's runtime rollout and showing queuing when CPU hits >80%. I'll patch config for canaries and restart edge pods. ETA ~10m.

sre-oncall: Oncall here — I'll keep infra alarms open and watch error-rate and pod restarts. If error-rate doesn't fall within 25m we consider escalating to network infra for packet-level tracing.

marta: Running pin and note: `releasectl pin --slot 10:30 --version v5.0.2 --reason "incident hold - ingress 5xx"` and `releasectl note --slot 10:30 --append "quarantined due to 5xx spike; DO_NOT_REQUEUE; pinned to v5.0.2"`. Also adding incident id to slot notes.

deploy-bot: Tentative slot created: 2026-06-10T18:00Z with micro-stagger 3m. Backfill policy: emergency fixes, security patches, docs only. Original slot 10:30 flagged DO_NOT_REQUEUE.

leo: Executing canary-only revert: `kubectl patch cm runtime-edge -n infra -p '{"data":{"batch-accel":"off"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart ds/edge-runtime`. Patching now.

anika: Patch applied; canary pods restarted. Early signal: 5xx on canaries down ~48% within 6m. Aggregate still slightly elevated; continuing watch on tail latencies and connection resets.

sre-oncall: No new infra alarms. Error-rate trending down but not back to baseline. Keeping watch for 30m before recommending slot clearance.

marta: Drafted customer comms for ops-status: "We're seeing elevated request errors in EU-West and have temporarily quarantined scheduled releases while engineers investigate. We'll update in 30 minutes or on resolution." Posting now.

leo: Adding postmortem stub and changelog entry so schedulers won't requeue the quarantined slot accidentally. `releasectl note --slot 10:30 --append "postmortem stub created; DO_NOT_REQUEUE"`.

anika: I've attached traces and a short revert-howto to the incident ticket in case the 18:00 canary shows regression.

deploy-bot: Quarantined slot remains blocked. Tentative 18:00 slot reserved for a staggered canary (3m cadence).

sre-oncall: If error-rate doesn't reach baseline within 30m we'll plan a full rollout rollback. For now, continue monitoring.

marta: Action recap: leo = canary revert & monitor; anika = traces + revert-howto; sre-oncall = infra watch & escalate; marta = pin, notes, and customer comms. Reconvene here in 25m.

leo: Quick reminder to teams: do not manually requeue the 10:30 slot. Use the 18:00 tentative window for low-risk or emergency patches.

anika: Metrics improving; aggregate 5xx down ~55% over last 10m. Will post another status update in 20m.

sre-oncall: Monitoring hooks remain; no escalation needed yet.

marta: Thanks all. Reopen thread if anything new pops up.
